title: Top Chicken: the record stayed at 6,186; the all-time leaderboard and recent history
summary: The all-time record stood at 6,186 likes, held by @cee.wtf, through all six results of the window. Each result post that can be listed says so in one line: "All-time top chicken is still cee.wtf with a score of 6186 to beat." Saturday's is below. The digest's Community games section gives the all-time leaderboard as it stood on Wed 18 Nov at 14:05Z, eight entries: 1. cee.wtf, 6,186. 2. sneptech.bsky.social, 5,852 (334 behind the record). 3. gracekind.net, 3,641 (2,545 behind). 4. octopodeeznuts.bsky.social, 3,411 (2,775 behind). 5. sneptech.bsky.social, 2,939 (3,247 behind). 6. isolyth.dev, 2,881 (3,305 behind). 7. cee.wtf, 2,733 (3,453 behind). 8. sneptech.bsky.social, 2,607 (3,579 behind). Two accounts hold five of the eight entries: sneptech.bsky.social three and cee.wtf two. The window against the record: the best result was Tuesday's 2,421, which is 39.1% of the record and 3,765 short of it. It is also 186 short of the eighth entry, so no result in the window reached the top eight. The lowest result was Saturday's 201, by the record holder (card games-top-chicken-saturday-201). Recent history, as far as the scraper fetched the game's own posts: 42 results from Fri 2 Oct to Thu 12 Nov, with a median winning score of 534.5 (the digest prints 535), a highest of 5,852, a lowest of 185, and 23 different winners as the digest counts them. Set among those 42 and the window's own six (48 results), the window's results rank 28th (Fri), 47th (Sat), 16th (Sun), 32nd (Mon), 4th (Tue) and 37th (Wed). Four of the six are below the recent median; the window's own median is 403. No result from 2 Oct to 18 Nov reached 6,186, so the record is older than the fetched history. When it was set is not in the digest. The game's leaderboard posts themselves cannot be shown or quoted (see "sensitive"). Everything about the leaderboard on this card is the digest's numbers.
